title: partner-cloud-marketplace-sync-prep
content:
Meeting: Weekly partner & cloud marketplace sync (AWS/Azure/GCP) - prep + follow-ups
Owner: Samira Khan (Partnerships)
Date: 2026-03-04 (weekly recurring)
Attendees (planned): Diego Morales (GTM), Priya Nair (Sales Eng), Alex Wu (Cloud BD - AWS), Leila Haddad (Cloud BD - GCP), Morgan (Channel partner ops)
Goal: Align on marketplace onboarding status, unblock technical/integration items, confirm go-to-market assets and timelines, and assign concrete follow-ups.

Context / background (quick):
- Two active marketplace efforts: AWS Marketplace (SaaS SaaS+Procurement listing), GCP Marketplace (billing integration in progress). Azure exploration paused until June pending legal review.
- Last week's highlights: AWS listing submitted (initial review), GCP lead from field requested meter/usage reporting example, PR created for billing test harness.
- Primary success metric for next 6 weeks: production listing + first customer proof-of-bill through marketplace for at least one cloud provider.

Agenda draft (30-45m):
1) Quick status round (5-7m) - each provider: 1 slide / 2 bullets
   - AWS: review current review status, remaining doc items, security questionnaire items
   - GCP: billing integration status, test harness results, outstanding dev work
   - Azure: legal blocker summary + proposed timeline
2) Technical blockers deep-dive (10-12m)
   - Metering schema: confirm final event schema for usage reporting (who owns?)
   - Billing test harness: test plan and current failures (Priya)
   - SSO/provisioning: SCIM vs custom provisioning options for marketplace users
3) GTM & launch assets (8-10m)
   - Marketplace listing copy, logos, screenshots (owner: Diego)
   - Pricing/quotas: confirm SKU structure and mapping to Redwood SKUs (owner: Finance touchpoint)
   - Sales enablement: one-pager / FAQ for field (owner: Priya)
4) Action items + owners + deadlines (5-8m)
5) AOB / next sync schedule (2m)

Prep notes (things I need to bring / confirm before meeting):
- AWS review ticket: snapshot of reviewer comments (pull from Confluence / support ticket) - Diego to share link in thread before sync.
- Billing harness logs: attach failing testcases (Priya) - request logs by EOD 03/03.
- Updated marketplace copy draft (Diego) - have v1 ready to share in meeting.
- Legal note for Azure: short summary (Morgan/Legal) - confirm if it’s an NDA/contract-related hold.
- Demo checklist (for potential partner demo): credits applied? sample invoice from marketplace? end-to-end flow documented?

Questions to ask partners/cloud reps:
- AWS: estimated timeline from initial submission to public listing? Any common gotchas they saw from similar vendors?
- GCP: specific expectations around usage metric naming and aggregation windows?
- Azure: which legal clause is blocking us and is there a pre-approved clause bank we can reference?

Follow-up action items (capture during meeting - draft owners/dates below):
- Diego: Post AWS reviewer comment snapshot + action plan into Confluence and share link (due 2026-03-05).
- Priya: Re-run billing harness with added verbosity and upload failing traces to S3 (/marketplace-tests/) (due 2026-03-06).
- Alex (AWS BD): Ask reviewer for estimated time-to-approval and any expedited review options; report back (due 2026-03-06).
- Leila (GCP BD): Confirm metric schema acceptance or provide required schema changes; add example JSON (due 2026-03-05).
- Morgan: Coordinate legal quick-review for Azure and confirm whether contract amendment or standard clause is required (due 2026-03-10).
- Samira (me): Compile GTM checklist and shared launch timeline (one pager) and circulate to GTM & Sales Eng (due 2026-03-07).

Notes to self / loose ideas (scratchpad):
- Consider pairing marketplace launch with a small co-marketing blog + webinar to drive first customers and get early telemetry.
- Track revenue attribution: we need simple SSO of purchase id to Redwood invoice id for downstream analytics - put on roadmap.
- If AWS review drags, consider listing on GCP first if billing path clears faster.

Risks / blockers to raise:
- Billing integration unknowns could delay proofs of billing — escalate to infra if tests continue to flake.
- Legal hold on Azure could push timeline > 6 weeks, deprioritize until legal provides concrete list.
- Resource contention: Priya overloaded next week; consider backfilling test work with SRE/infra support.

Meeting follow-up template (to send after meeting):
- Subject: [Action required] Marketplace sync notes + actions (provider names) - {date}
- Body: 1-2 sentence summary, then bullet list of action items (owner + due date), links to artifacts (Confluence, logs, tickets), next meeting date.

Quick links to attach in meeting invite:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRT/AWS+Marketplace+onboarding
- Billing harness S3: s3://redwood-marketplace-tests (confirm perms)
- JIRA board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/RapidBoard.jspa?rapidView=22

TODO before join:
- Ping Diego to confirm he uploaded AWS reviewer comments link (if not, ask Alex to bring in-meeting).
- Confirm Priya can demo one failing billing test case during the call.
- Attach marketplace copy v1 to invite as read-ahead.

-- end of prep doc --

(Keep this as users scratchpad; after meeting, convert to short summary + action list and move final to shared_drives/product/hosted-api/marketplace or confluence per GTM process.)
